description_en: Queries the plan information about an SQL statement such as a query statement or an extract-transform-load (ETL) task statement
description_zh: 调用DescribeSQLPlan接口查询目标SQL，例如查询语句或ETL（Extract Transform Load）任务语句的计划信息
name: DescribeSQLPlan

parameters.help_en:
The cluster ID.

> You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html operation to query the information about all AnalyticDB for MySQL clusters within a region, including cluster IDs
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。
> 您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html接口查看目标地域下所有AnalyticDB MySQL集群的详情，包括集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The query ID.

>  You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/612277.html operation to query the IDs of queries that are being executed

任务ID。
